description: Department of Cooperative Development - Cancellation of the Registration Cooperative Societies in Nuwara Eliya District.
categorisation: This gazette notification concerns the cancellation of registration for multiple cooperative societies under provincial cooperative legislation. It deals with business/commercial matters (specifically the dissolution of registered business entities) rather than government personnel, structure, land, legal, electoral, public service, judicial, or other administrative matters. The content focuses on commercial registrations and deregistrations, fitting the Commercial (Type 6) classification.
